'''Fabool''' were balloon-like creatures that lived in the Dantarian savannas on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Their main threat was being punctured by the thorns of the native [[Blba tree/Legends|blba tree]]. They were used by the [[Dantari]] to make fabool-hide pouches.
